selection.baseline: CheckUp00 for each cell, using same-cell capacity, 10 s resistance, and same-SOC EIS
selection.score_rows: Every later checkup with finite capacity, finite 10 s resistance, and a complete EIS file
selection.cells: All cells satisfying the baseline and score-row rules; no post-score cell filtering
selection.frequency_mapping: Mean exact duplicate frequencies, then linear interpolation in log10 frequency without extrapolation
selection.imaginary_sign: znegimag = -1 * published Imaginary Part of Impedance
selection.soh_percent: 100 * current measured capacity / CheckUp00 measured capacity
selection.rint_increase_percent: 100 * (current published 10 s pulse resistance - CheckUp00 value) / CheckUp00 value

acceptance.performance: Each EIS head pooled RMSE and each SOH head MAE on accepted rows must be at least 5 percent below its frozen baseline
acceptance.uncertainty: Each frozen nominal-90-percent interval must achieve at least 80 percent empirical coverage on accepted rows
acceptance.domain_guard: Use the frozen threshold unchanged; require at least 10 accepted rows from at least 3 cells

claim_boundary: One untouched external NMC pouch-cell dataset. Correlated SOC/checkup rows are reported with cell counts and do not become independent batteries.
